name: Halal Terminal API
description:
The **Halal Terminal API** is the most comprehensive Islamic finance data
platform available — 85 REST endpoints, 25 MCP tools, and 7 AI resources
across 21 categories covering Shariah screening, market data, portfolio
compliance, ETF analysis, news, SEC filings, dividends, zakat calculators,
and more. Connect via REST API or MCP (Model Context Protocol) for AI-native access.

---

## Quick start

**1. Get a free API key** — no credit card required:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.halalterminal.com/api/keys/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "you@example.com"}'
```

**2. Screen your first stock:**

```bash
curl https://api.halalterminal.com/api/screen/AAPL \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_KEY"
```

**3. Parse the response:**

```json
{
  "symbol": "AAPL",
  "is_compliant": true,
  "compliance_status": "COMPLIANT",
  "revenue_breakdown": { ... },
  "financial_ratios": { ... }
}
```

That's it — you're screening.

---

## Authentication

Every `/api/*` request must include your key in the `X-API-Key` header.

**Exempt endpoints** (no key required): `GET /api/health`,
`POST /api/keys/generate`, `GET /api/keys/plans`, `GET /api/keys/token-costs`.
Everything else — including billing checkout/portal — requires the key.

### Code examples

**Python**
```python
import requests

headers = {"X-API-Key": "YOUR_KEY"}
r = requests.get(
    "https://api.halalterminal.com/api/screen/AAPL",
    headers=headers,
)
print(r.json())
```

**JavaScript (fetch)**
```javascript
const res = await fetch(
  "https://api.halalterminal.com/api/screen/AAPL",
  { headers: { "X-API-Key": "YOUR_KEY" } }
);
const data = await res.json();
```

---

## Plans & token-based pricing

| Plan | Tokens / month | Price | Overage |
|------|---------------:|------:|---------|
| **Free** | 500 | $0 | Hard block |
| **Starter** | 2,500 | $19/mo | $0.01/token |
| **Pro** | 15,000 | $49/mo | $0.008/token |
| **Enterprise** | 50,000 | $199/mo | $0.005/token (no hard cap) |

Each API request costs a certain number of **tokens** depending on the
endpoint. Lightweight reads (database search, news) cost **1 token**,
standard reads (quotes, OHLC) cost **2 tokens**, screening and heavy
operations cost **5–50 tokens**. Free endpoints (health, education,
api-keys, billing, watchlist reads) cost **0 tokens**.

See the full cost table at [`GET /api/keys/token-costs`](/api/keys/token-costs).

**Overage**: Free plan hard-blocks at the limit. Paid plans continue
at the per-token overage rate — you're never locked out. Token usage
resets monthly.

Upgrade anytime via the [billing endpoint](/api/billing/checkout).

---

## Common recipes

| Use case | Endpoint | Method |
|----------|----------|--------|
| Screen a single stock | `/api/screen/AAPL` | GET |
| Bulk-screen an index | `/api/screen-bulk` | POST |
| Get real-time quote | `/api/quote/{symbol}` | GET |
| Check portfolio compliance | `/api/portfolio/scan` | POST |
| Screen an ETF's holdings | `/api/etf/{symbol}/screening` | GET |
| Calculate zakat | `/api/zakat/calculate` | POST |
| Calculate dividend purification | `/api/dividends/{symbol}/purification` | GET |
| Search the stock database | `/api/database/search?q=apple` | GET |
| Get market news | `/api/news/market` | GET |
| Fetch SEC filings | `/api/filings/{symbol}` | GET |

---

## Error handling

All errors return a consistent JSON envelope:

```json
{
  "code": "ERROR_CODE",
  "message": "Human-readable explanation",
  "detail": null
}
```

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| 400 | `HTTP_400` | Bad request — check parameters |
| 401 | `API_KEY_REQUIRED` | Missing `X-API-Key` header |
| 401 | `INVALID_API_KEY` | Key does not exist |
| 403 | `API_KEY_DEACTIVATED` | Key has been disabled |
| 404 | `HTTP_404` | Resource not found |
| 429 | `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | Monthly quota exhausted — upgrade plan |
| 429 | `OVERAGE_CAP_REACHED` | Pay-as-you-go spend cap hit for this billing period (paid plans; resets at `billing_period_end`) |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Server error — retry or contact support |

---

## Rate limits & headers

Every authenticated response includes:

| Header | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `X-Request-ID` | Unique request identifier for debugging |
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Monthly token allowance for your plan (`unlimited` on unmetered plans) |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Tokens remaining in the current billing period |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Unix timestamp when your billing period (and quota) resets |
| `X-Plan` | Your current plan |
| `X-Tokens-Charged` | Number of tokens deducted for this request |
| `X-Tokens-Remaining` | Legacy alias of `X-RateLimit-Remaining` |
| `X-Tokens-Overage` | Present and set to `true` when the request exceeded the plan allowance |

**Result freshness:** screening verdicts are cached and refreshed on a rolling
basis; a cached result can be up to **7 days** old. `GET /api/result/{symbol}`
(1 token) reads the cache; `POST /api/screen/{symbol}` (5 tokens) recomputes.
Each result carries `last_checked_at` and `is_stale` so you can decide.

When you hit your quota the `429` response includes your current
`plan`, `tokens_limit`, and `tokens_used` in the `detail` field.

---
